usage: Used for shopping in general, especially going out to buy things in stores or malls.
Very common in everyday spoken Cantonese; sounds natural and casual.
Often appears with verbs like 去 and 做, for example talking about going shopping or doing shopping.
Can refer to buying things for daily needs, not only clothes or big purchases.

examples.meaning: I want to go shopping tomorrow.
